card.name: Modifier right before the word drugs
card.fires_on: A modifier such as other, related, oral or taking that sits just before the word drugs or products. It is common in drug-interaction text, as in 'with other drugs'.

modes.label: Other/related before drugs
modes.description: The word other, related or oral comes after with, of or and, and the next word is drugs, products or medications.
modes.example: Consider increased clinical or laboratory monitoring when co-administered with<< other>> oral medications that have a narrow therapeutic index

modes.label: Start of a drug class phrase
modes.description: The first piece of a drug class name or a verb comes just before the word drugs or inhibitors.
modes.example: Fast Facts About PPIsWhen it comes to this popular class of medications, here's what you need to know. - Do Over-the-Counter<< Pro>>ton Pump Inhibitors Work?You

card.writes: It pushes the model away from predicting 'books' or 'products' as the next word, which points toward a drug-related noun instead.
card.plain: It fires on a small word like 'other' that is about to be followed by 'drugs' in an interaction sentence.
